entities.summary: Kobe City University of Foreign Studies , KCUFS for short, is a municipal university in Japan. It is located in Gakuen-higashimachi, Nishi-ku, Kobe City. Kobe City University of Foreign Studies is a university in Asia, established in 1946. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
